chunks.text: Isla Dawson is an island of Chile's Magallanes region and is recognized by SBAP/SIMBIO as a geoform of the Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes marine ecosystem (ECOMAR-058).

SBAP/SIMBIO also recognizes regional terrestrial and watershed contexts associated with Isla Dawson, including the watershed unit Islas Dawson, Wickam y adyacentes. These relationships are ecological and hydrological context, not administrative boundaries.

Institutional historical material places northern Isla Dawson in a former glacial-lake paleoenvironmental context together with Bahia Inutil and Segunda Angostura. This is historical geological context and should not be interpreted as a description of present hydrology.
